name: tauri-template-app
description: Template app: Tauri + TypeScript frontend, Python/FastAPI backend, and a CLI client. Sample code prints hello world.

scripts.server:install: cd src/server && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,app -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b src_future/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace src/app
